summary: Iteration 2: validated newsletter feature (backend + frontend) and re-ran full regression now that the Shopify Storefront token is LIVE. Backend pytest 13/13 passing; frontend newsletter flows (form, success card, coupon, clipboard copy, duplicate submit, PT/EN i18n) all pass; cart -> real Shopify checkout on lojavirtualvision.com confirmed. One minor UX gap noted on newsletter input HTML5 validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Email input is type="email" and the <form> has no noValidate, so the browser's native HTML5 popup blocks submission for clearly malformed inputs (e.g. 'not-an-email'). The React onSubmit never runs in that case, so the custom data-testid="newsletter-error" element is NEVER rendered for inputs without '@'. The custom error DOES render for inputs that pass HTML5 but fail the JS regex (e.g. 'abc@b'). Recommend either adding noValidate to <motion.form> or changing input type to text so the custom regex-based error and styled message always show.

issues: Footer 'Loja' links still hardcoded to demo handles (Tech / Moda / Decoração / Ferramentas) while the live Shopify store actually exposes handles 'mejores-ventas', 'nuevos-arribos', 'ofertas'. Clicking these footer links does not filter to anything real. Cosmetic — not in scope for this iteration but worth flagging.

action_items: (Low) Newsletter form: add noValidate on the <form> (or use type="text" on input) so the custom data-testid="newsletter-error" message renders for ALL invalid emails, including those rejected by HTML5 (e.g. 'not-an-email'). Backend already covers all variants with 400.
(Cosmetic, optional) Footer 'Loja' category links don't match the live Shopify collection handles — either map to live handles or hide when data_source='shopify'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/store/checkout still has dead-code total calculation in the demo branch (lines ~262-264). Minor.
Newsletter endpoint correctly excludes _id from MongoDB find_one projection and response payload — verified.
EMAIL_RE on backend matches the same JS regex on the frontend (^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$), so backend/frontend validation are consistent.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_store_api.py (rewritten to expect data_source='shopify' and added TestNewsletter class with 8 cases)
seed_data_creation: Each newsletter test uses a unique uuid-suffixed email (no cleanup needed); count endpoint verified by delta.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shopify token is LIVE — backend /api/store/* endpoints now return data_source='shopify' with real BRL pricing; /api/store/checkout returns real cart with checkoutUrl pointing to lojavirtualvision.com. The store exposes 3 collection handles (mejores-ventas, nuevos-arribos, ofertas); demo handles (tech/moda/decoracao/ferramentas) are NOT present in the live store, so any test that asserts those handles in /api/store/collections will fail unless token is rolled back. Newsletter feature uses MongoDB collection 'newsletter_subscribers'; do NOT clear it between runs — use uuid-suffixed emails. Frontend newsletter input has HTML5 type=email which blocks browser submit for obvious non-emails; the custom error testid only renders for inputs that pass HTML5 but fail the stricter JS regex.
